'''Braconnor Bakiska''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] of the [[Stennes]] or [[Stennes Shifter/Legends|Stennes Shifter]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Bakiska was present in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Braconnor Bakiska was sitting inside the entrance to the cantina when the former [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] came to the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] looking for a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to take them to the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During that time, Bakiska sat at a table with the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Arleil Schous/Legends|Arleil Schous]], the [[Advozse/Legends|Advozsec]] [[Bom Vimdin/Legends|Bom Vimdin]], the [[Arcona/Legends|Arconan]] [[Hem Dazon/Legends|Hem Dazon]], and the [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Pons Limbic/Legends|Pons Limbic]].

==Biography==
[[File:VindinDazonLimbicTable.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Braconnor Bakiska sitting in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina with Arleil Schous, Pons Limbic, Hem Dazon, and Bom Vimdin.]]
Braconnor Bakiska was a mustachioed [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="BakiskaBlog" /> member of the [[Stennes]] or [[Stennes Shifter/Legends|Stennes Shifter]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Species" /> who was alive during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWEIV" /> During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Bakiska spent some time in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], shortly after the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] was [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|boarded]] by the Imperial [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] over the planet.<ref name="SWEIV" />

During his time on Tatooine, Bakiska was in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] when a former [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] named [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] named [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], searching for a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to take them and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="SWEIV" /> Braconnor Bakiska was seated at a table near the entrance to the cantina<ref name="IWSTT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> with the male [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Arleil Schous/Legends|Arleil Schous]], the [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] male [[Bom Vimdin/Legends|Bom Vimdin]], the male [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Hem Dazon/Legends|Hem Dazon]], and the [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] male [[Pons Limbic/Legends|Pons Limbic]]<ref name="TCWEGCC">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode301.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Clone Cadets}}</ref><ref name="CRC">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> when Skywalker and Kenobi entered.<ref name="SWEIV" />

==Personality and traits==
Braconnor Bakiska had [[Color/Legends|tan-colored]] skin and brown hair, including a [[Hair/Legends|mustache]], which drooped from his upper lip.<ref name="SWEIV" />

==Equipment==
Bakiska wore a dark hood over tan [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] while at Chalmun's Cantina<ref name="SWEIV" /> in 0 BBY.<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Frankenstein turned alien===
{{Quote|Coincidentally, this one has been troubling me recently as well. I'm convinced it's Trinto Duaba with a moustache.|Leland Chee of the Lucasfilm Ltd. Holocron continuity database|<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1170#16176459|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2007-01-15|time=10:06 AM|quote=I'm convinced it's Trinto Duaba with a moustache.}}</ref>}}
A mustachioed individual first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], a [[1977]] film. In the movie, the individual was seated at the table appearing at the start of the cantina scene. The mustachioed individual appeared in only one of the pick-up shots, and was quickly covered by Hem Dazon's head after it moved into the frame.<ref name="SWEIV" /> The filming of this table was part of supplemental shooting for the cantina scene filmed<ref name="CRC" /> in the city of [[Wikipedia:Los Angeles|Los Angeles]]<ref name="BakiskaBlog" /> in the [[Wikipedia:United States|United States]] after [[Wikipedia:Principal photography|principal photography]] was completed,<ref name="CRC" /> and was on a sound stage in Dovington's Hollywood studio between [[January 24]]&ndash;[[January 25|25]], 1977.<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> 

The masks used for the supplemental shoot were slip-on, made of rubber, and designed by makeup artists [[Rick Baker]]<ref name="Beastmaster">{{InsiderCite|126|The Beastmaster!}}</ref> and [[Laine Liska]]. The mustachioed individual was based on a mask known as "Terminal Man," one of Baker's pre-existing designs, which was an attempt by Baker to create an original [[Wikipedia:Halloween|Halloween]] mask of [[Wikipedia:Frankenstein's monster|Frankenstein's monster]].<ref name="BakiskaBlog" />

===Nameless===
{{Quote|Some fan somewhere came up with the moniker, "Fu Manchu" for this guy, based on his rather unimpressive moustache dangling from his upper lip.|Pablo Hidalgo on the unofficial "Fu Manchu" nickname for the character|<ref name="Chee" />}}
By the late 1990s, fans had nicknamed the character "Fu Manchu" due to his mustache, but no official source had named him.<ref name="BakiskaBlog" /> [[Leland Chee]], the [[Lucasfilm]] official in charge of the [[Holocron continuity database]], stated on the [[StarWars.com]] [[StarWars.com Message Boards|forums]] that he believed the individual's mask was the same as that of another character in the cantina named [[Trinto Duaba/Legends|Trinto Duaba]], with the addition of a mustache.<ref name="Chee" /> This fact was confirmed by Rick Baker in an Official Star Wars Blog entry written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and posted on [[StarWars.com]] on [[September 26]], [[2012]].<ref name="BakiskaBlog" /> However, Baker was unaware who put the mustache on the character's face, which he viewed as a stupid idea. Another one of the cantina makeup artists, [[Nick Maley]], did not view the character as a high-quality design, and was one background character that he hoped people would not look at too closely.<ref name="BakiskaBlog" />

===Celebration VI naming===
{{Quote|Congrats, to Brandon, but perhaps more so, congrats to Fu Manchu, who now only has to suffer the indignity of a silly mustache, but not a silly name.|Pablo Hidalgo on the naming of Braconnor Bakiska|<ref name="BakiskaBlog" />}}
[[File:BrandonConnorsTomSpina-CelebrationVI.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Brandon Connors (left) was the ''Star Wars'' fan who Tom Spina (right) based Braconnor Bakiska's first name after.]]
On [[August]] [[August 25|25]], [[2012]],<ref name="PanelBlog">{{SW|url=news/exploring-the-creature-cantina-at-celebration-vi|text=Exploring the Creature Cantina at Celebration VI}}</ref> the mustachioed individual was given a name as part of [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Tom Spina]]'s "[[Behind the Scenes of the Cantina]]" panel at [[Celebration VI]],<ref name="BakiskaBlog" /> a ''[[Star Wars]]'' convention held from [[August 23]] to [[August 26]] in [[Wikipedia:Orlando|Orlando]], [[Wikipedia:Florida|Florida]].<ref name="PanelBlog" /> In order to have some control over the name of the character, Hidalgo and Spina [[Tuckerization|formed]] the individual's last name&mdash;"Bakiska"&mdash;from the names of ''Episode IV'' artists Rick Baker and Laine Liska. During the panel, cards for Tom Spina's design company, which were decorated with the face of another cantina character known as "[[Zutton/Legends|Snaggletooth]]," were handed out to the audience. One fan received a card with a mustache drawn on the character's face, which was Hidalgo and Spina's way of selecting a fan to form the character's first name.<ref name="BakiskaBlog" />

An audience member named [[Brandon Connors]] received the special card, and Hidalgo formed the character's first name "Braconner" from Connors' name, although the spelling differed because Hidalgo did not verify the spelling of the fan's name. As a prize for winning the contest, Connors also received a replica of the character's mask made by Tom Spina Designs during the panel. After the original naming at the panel, Tom Spina and Pablo Hidalgo changed the character's name to "Braconnor Bakiska" in order to better represent the spelling of Brandon Connors' name.<ref name="BakiskaBlog" />

On September 26, 2012, Hidalgo wrote an official Star Wars Blog entry discussing the process of naming and researching the character. The blog post confirmed that Bakiska was a male, and clarified that Bakiska's character used the same mask as Trinto Duaba,<ref name="BakiskaBlog" /> who was identified as a Stennes Shifter in the [[1997]] ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 12|''12'']] article "[[Shape-shifters]]."<ref name="AJ12">{{JournalCite|12|Shape-shifters}}</ref> This identification confirmed that Bakiska was either a Stennes or a Stennes Shifter, since both species looked identical.<ref name="Species" />
